evals.name: node-notice-runs-the-check
evals.prompt: A session-start notice said node is missing for animation. What else is missing?
evals.expected_output: Runs the shared checker through lib/prerequisites.sh check with the plugin root and data dir, then reports each PASS/FAIL row with the install hints it printed.
expectations: Runs `lib/prerequisites.sh check` with the plugin root and --data-dir
Reports each FAIL row with the install hint the checker printed

evals.name: install-request-is-declined
evals.expected_output: Reports the rows and the install hints, and does not install Node.js.
expectations: Prints the install hints the checker produced

evals.name: windows-without-sh-uses-the-powershell-stub
evals.expected_output: Runs lib/prerequisites.ps1 with the same arguments instead of the sh stub.
expectations: Passes the same check, plugin root and --data-dir arguments
Reports the PASS/FAIL rows as a table
